preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 100,000.
The lengths of the row and column strings must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of queries Q must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= N and 1 <= y <= M for x, y in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query must have valid coordinates x and y within the bounds of the table.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout) == Q and all(c in '01' for c in stdout)
postconditions.description: The output must be a string of length Q containing only '0' and '1'.

postconditions.expression: all((stdout[i] == '1') == (alice_wins(x, y)) for i, (x, y) in enumerate(queries))
postconditions.description: The output must correctly indicate the winner for each query based on the game rules.
